newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch closing share market report.
newsitem.headline: Dutch closing share market report.

text.p: Dutch shares closed lower after a mixed session on Monday and dealers said business would remain thin in coming days.
The Dutch market is closed on Wednesday due to Queens Day and most European markets are closed on Thursday, May 1.
Dollar was main supportive element today, but uptrend came to a halt in afternoon trade, which also stopped further rise of the AEX share index.
The main share index closed 2.86 points lower at 749.76.
Most dealers foresee a sideways pattern for the coming week, by Dutch chartists were more upbeat.

Chemical firm Akzo Nobel was main discord in an overall sluggish market. Akzo Nobel fell 9.50 guilders to 252.50, as investors showed their disappointment with last Friday's slight rise in first quarter results.
Business in financial shares fizzled out in afternoon trade as the bond market edged into negative territory.
Insurer Aegon ended 0.50 guilders higher at 137.30.
Market players said they were awaiting Tuesday's U.S. durable goods data, but the main focus were Friday's U.S. unemployment and payrolls.
Airline company KLM bucked the trend to close 0.70 guilders higher at 56.20.
